sources.title: GitHub - microsoft/GridSFM: Small Foundation Models for the Power Grid
sources.snippet: Download the dataset — use the HuggingFace loader bundled with the gridsfm package to fetch the power grid models and OPF results to a local directory. Inspect the data — launch the browser-based viewer to explore network topology and OPF results. Run the topology solver pipeline — process raw topologies into solved AC-OPF scenarios for model training.

sources.title: GridFM - Microsoft Research
sources.snippet: GridFM is a Microsoft Research initiative to build a foundation model (FM) for electric power grids to increase the speed of AC-OPF solutions, applying modern AI methods—similar to large language/weather models—to complex grid physics.
